description: This source file defines the class {@link SubjectsNotModifiableException}, a custom exception indicating that modification of subjects within a policy entry failed due to insufficient permissions. The class is part of the package related to policy exceptions in the Eclipse Ditto project and includes builder patterns for creating instances, as well as methods for constructing exceptions from messages and JSON representations.

classes.name: SubjectsNotModifiableException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating that subjects of a policy entry could not be modified due to permission issues. It contains static methods for instantiation and a nested builder class.

classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing instances of SubjectsNotModifiableException with a fluent API.
